name: follow2d
description: Following: an entity glides after another one, at a distance, behind it or ahead of it, and may float around that place. Companions, pets, a crowd that trails a leader, a marker that hovers over what it points at.

components.name: Follow
components.description: Moves the entity's Position towards a place near its target: the entity that answers to target (a tag.Tag; the oldest when several do), or with owner the entity of its transform2d.Owner. The place is the target's Position moved by (offset_x, offset_y). stiffness is the share of the distance covered each tick: 1 sticks to the place, 0.1 glides after it, 0 does not move. With turn, offset_x is the one for a target going right (a negative one is behind it, a positive one ahead of it) and is turned round when the target goes left (its transform2d.Velocity x below -1), so that the follower stays behind it, or ahead of it, whichever way it goes; side keeps the way it last went (1 right, -1 left). ahead moves the place that many units further along the way the target moves, in any direction (a light ahead of a diver, the pull ahead of a swimmer, a guide ahead of a ship); the module keeps speed, how fast the target goes (a picture can grow while it moves), and dir_x and dir_y, the way it last went (a length of 1). wave_x and wave_y make the place float around: it moves back and forth by up to that many units, along x and along y, once every wave_period seconds (the y wave goes twice as fast as the x one, so together they draw a slow figure of eight). side, time (the seconds into the wave), speed, dir_x and dir_y are the module's own state. Nothing happens while the target is missing. With way_x and way_y (two actions, such as a stick's or the arrows' move_x and move_y), the way is the one they point to while they point somewhere, not the one the target goes: a pull, a sight or a shield held ahead of a character where the player points. way_turn (degrees a second, 0 at once) turns the way round towards the new one at most so fast: what is ahead goes round the target, as the stick goes round.

systems.name: follow
systems.description: Moves every Follow entity towards the place near its target, after the targets have moved this tick.
